n = int(input())
left = list(map(int, input().split()))
right = list(map(int, input().split()))

total_left = sum(left)
total_right = sum(right)

# For at least one matching pair
# Worst case: pick all from one side that exists in other, minus one set
min_gloves = total_left + total_right - max(left) - max(right) + 2

# Minimum to guarantee a pair
result = min_gloves
for i in range(n):
    if left[i] > 0 and right[i] > 0:
        result = min(result, left[i] + right[i] + 1)

print(result)
print(total_left + total_right)

x = int(input())

# Find which diagonal
diag = 1
sum_diag = 1
while sum_diag < x:
    diag += 1
    sum_diag += diag

# Position in diagonal
pos = x - (sum_diag - diag)

if diag % 2 == 0:
    # Even diagonal: goes up (numerator increases)
    numerator = pos
    denominator = diag - pos + 1
else:
    # Odd diagonal: goes down (denominator increases)
    numerator = diag - pos + 1
    denominator = pos

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
